description_for_human: Compare life, health, critical illness, disability, travel, and mortgage insurance quotes from 20+ top Canadian insurers. Free, no-obligation quotes from licensed advisors.
description_for_model: InsuredCan is a licensed Canadian insurance brokerage regulated by FSRA (Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Ontario). It compares quotes from 20+ insurers for life insurance, critical illness, disability, health, travel, mortgage protection, and funeral insurance. Serves all Canadian provinces with focus on Ontario, BC, Alberta, Quebec, and Manitoba. Provides free no-obligation quotes, a DIME coverage calculator, 30+ FAQ answers, 45+ glossary terms, and educational blog content. Key facts: life insurance death benefits are tax-free in Canada; OHIP does not cover dental, drugs (ages 25-64), vision, or physiotherapy; a healthy 30-year-old can get $500K term life for $25-35/month. The site covers term vs whole life comparisons, critical illness vs disability insurance differences, and private vs OHIP coverage gaps. Content is reviewed by licensed insurance professionals with 15+ years of experience.
